intro: Meridith the Mermaiden has a message for Narain Soothfancy, the gnome she once rescued from the wreckage of a crashed flying machine. She asks you to carry her love letter to him in Tanaris. You can take this up while seeking Narain's book in Draconic for Dummies.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It isn't often that I get visitors. As a matter of fact, the last time I had a visitor was when I rescued that dear, sweet gnome from the wreckage of the crashed flying machine.
Do you know him? Narain? Narain Soothfancy? Oh it would mean so much to me if somebody would deliver a message to him for me. I must tell him how I feel! I know it's love! I just know it!
Could you possibly deliver a message to Narain? I would be forever indebted to you!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well, um... What do you want me to do??? She's a fish! A FISH I tell you! And I'm a gnome. It could never work out.
